description: Single email with custom sender for phishing campaign simulation

payload.subject: Urgent: Security Verification Required
payload.htmlContent:
Account Security Alert

Dear User,

We've detected unusual activity on your account. Please verify your identity by clicking the link below:

Verify Account

Thank you,
Security Team
payload.textContent: Account Security Alert - We've detected unusual activity. Please verify your identity at: https://phishing-sim.com/verify

notes: ✅ Custom fromName: Security Team (trusted sender name)
✅ Subject creates urgency typical in phishing campaigns
✅ Perfect for testing user awareness of phishing attempts
